description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the GetProductInfoByIds operation for online calls to the Taobao Alliance edition
description_zh: 本文为您介绍GetProductInfoByIds接口的语法及示例，用于向淘宝联盟版在线调用
kebab_example: aliyun imagesearch get-product-info-by-ids --item-ids 111,22,33 --pid mm_xxx_xxx_xxx --fields Url,UserType --api-version 2021-05-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetProductInfoByIds

parameters.help_en: The product ID string. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 40 IDs are supported
parameters.name: item_ids

parameters.help_en:
The PID. For more information, see PID (https://mos.m.taobao.com/union/pub/site/help?spm=a219t.11817172.PortalLayout.d52e56935.27ac6a15wlAEHe).
This field is available when you use SDK V1.1.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
PID。具体请参考PID (https://mos.m.taobao.com/union/pub/site/help?spm=a219t.11817172.PortalLayout.d52e56935.27ac6a15wlAEHe)。
使用V1.1.0及以上版本的SDK可用该字段
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en: The list of fields to return. Separate different fields with commas (,). By default, the PicUrl, ReservePrice, Title, Url, and ZkFinalPrice fields are always returned
parameters.help_zh: 需要返回的字段list。不同的字段用逗号分割。默认PicUrl,ReservePrice,Title,Url,ZkFinalPrice字段必返回
parameters.name: fields
